data.gender_notes: Petka is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'petra' meaning 'rock' or 'stone'. In Christian tradition, the name Petka is associated with the Apostle Peter, who is referred to as the 'Rock' upon which the Church is built. The name Petka carries the meaning “Rock, Stone” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Petka usually hope their child will grow to embody rock, stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of strength and steadfastness in faith.
data.etymology: Petka belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rock, Stone.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Petka total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
